headline: US forces strike military site in Iran near Yasuj
summary: The attack follows a week of tensions over shipping lanes in the Strait of Hormuz, with Iran launching retaliatory strikes in Middle Eastern countries.
details: US forces have carried out an airstrike on a military facility on the outskirts of Yasuj, in Iran's southwestern Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad province, according to security officials.
The Iranian state news agency IRIB reported the attack, but officials have not yet provided immediate information regarding casualties or the extent of the damage.
The strike is part of a series of three US airstrikes conducted over the past week in response to Iranian attacks on ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz.
Washington claims that Iran has been targeting vessels even those using alternative routes to avoid international waters.
In response, Iran has launched strikes against several countries in the Middle East where US troops are stationed.
Tehran has reaffirmed its right to control the Strait of Hormuz and has warned that it may take steps to collect fees from ships passing through the waterway.
caption:
US forces strike military site in Iran. Tensions escalate as both nations exchange retaliatory blows in the Middle East.

US forces have carried out an airstrike on a military facility on the outskirts of Yasuj, in Iran's southwestern Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad province, according to security officials.

The Iranian state news agency IRIB reported the attack, but officials have not yet provided immediate information regarding casualties or the extent of the damage.

The strike is part of a series of three US airstrikes conducted over the past week in response to Iranian attacks on ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz.

Washington claims that Iran has been targeting vessels even those using alternative routes to avoid international waters.

In response, Iran has launched strikes against several countries in the Middle East where US troops are stationed.

Tehran has reaffirmed its right to control the Strait of Hormuz and has warned that it may take steps to collect fees from ships passing through the waterway.

headline_marked: 60,000 [[marooned in Banshkhali]] as fresh rain hits Chattogram
headline: 60,000 marooned in Banshkhali as fresh rain hits Chattogram
summary: While floodwaters recede in some areas, continuous rainfall has worsened the situation in Banshkhali, leaving thousands stranded and causing massive agricultural losses.
details: Fresh rainfall has left approximately 60,000 people marooned in Banshkhali, Chattogram, as water levels rose by another one to two inches in some areas. While floodwaters have started receding in parts of Satkania, the situation in Banshkhali remains critical.

Upazila Nirbahi Officer Md Ruhul Amin stated that many residents are avoiding government shelters, preferring to stay with relatives on higher ground. However, many homes remain submerged, and power outages continue to disrupt daily life.

The floods have caused extensive damage to agriculture and fisheries across the division. Official estimates indicate that 14,300 hectares of cropland and nearly 10,000 commercial fish ponds and shrimp enclosures have been damaged.

The fisheries sector alone has suffered an estimated loss of Tk 39 crore. Health officials have also warned of an increased risk of waterborne diseases due to submerged tube wells and limited access to safe drinking water.
Across the Chattogram Division, the latest floods have affected more than 866,000 people and claimed at least 43 lives, with over 1,700 shelters opened to provide refuge.

The Bangladesh Meteorological Department recorded 142.7mm of rainfall in Chattogram in the 24 hours leading up to today. Heavy rain is expected to continue until tomorrow afternoon before easing to moderate levels.
